name: Verdict
effectName: Many Oaths of Dawn and Dusk
effectTemplate: Increases ATK by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color>. When party members obtain Elemental Shards from Crystallize or trigger Lunar-Crystallize reactions, the equipping character will gain 1 Seal, increasing Elemental Skill DMG by <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color>. The Seal lasts for 15s, and the equipper may have up to 2 Seals at once. All of the equipper's Seals will disappear 0.2s after their Elemental Skill deals DMG. Up to 1 Seal may be obtained every second through the Lunar-Crystallize reaction.
